title: What does PalmsPlay Rewards do, can you explain it in detail?
description: We are the provider of online entertainment platform and bring to our members a variety of entertainment.

title: How do I play games with my Bonus Gold and Palms Gold coins?
description: Go to https://play-demo.palmsplay.com from the lobby, select the switch coin symbol located at the top right- hand side of the user interface. Once selected the gold coin lobby will appear from behind the curtains, and you may select from the promotional games available.

title: What are unqualified coins?
description: Unqualified coins are free bonus gold coins received when you make a silver package purchase from our Shop. Bonus gold coins (unqualified coins) remain unqualified for prize redemption until play-through requirements have been met. Bonus gold coins cannot be purchased.

title: Why can't I claim my raffle prize?
description: To protect the integrity of the Palms Play Rewards Program, all raffle prize claims are subject to eligibility verification. You may be unable to claim a raffle prize if: You have not met all qualification requirements for the applicable raffle. You do not meet the eligibility requirements set out in the Palms Play Terms & Conditions. Your account has not been successfully verified or you have not provided any required identification. Your account has been identified as being in breach of the Rewards Program or Terms & Conditions, including fraudulent, abusive, or suspicious activity. The prize cannot legally be awarded in your jurisdiction. If your prize claim cannot be processed, our team will contact you if any additional information or documentation is required.

title: How long does it take to receive my raffle prize?
description: Once your raffle prize claim has been verified and approved, prizes are generally processed within 14 business days. Processing times may vary depending on the type of prize, your location, and the completion of any required identity or eligibility checks. If additional information is needed, our team will contact you directly.
